jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: Life at Kueez Kueez Monetization Suite End2End Marketing Platform About Us Careers Contact Us p p p Kueez Monetizations Suite End2End Marketing Platform About us Careers Contact us Life at Kueez We move fast, think big, and continuously push boundaries to stay ahead in a competitive digital landscape - all while keeping things fun, collaborative, and down to earth. How It All Started Kueez launched in 2016 with a clear ambition: to create a content platform offering light, wholesome entertainment. Identifying the limitations of existing online publishing tools in a rapidly evolving digital landscape, we developed an innovative, performance-driven solution. Our cutting-edge technology streamlined and enhanced every aspect of the publishing process. By 2018, our proprietary technology powered over 120 websites, reaching more than 200 million monthly readers. This rapid growth earned us recognition from SimilarWeb as one of the top 10 fastest-growing publishers in the United States. Where We Are Today Today, Kueez is a leading force in global digital publishing and performance marketing technology. Our commitment to excellence has placed us among Israel’s 10 fastest-growing companies, as recognized by Globes and Statista. At the heart of our success is a deep commitment to our people - their well-being, growth, and development - fostering a culture where talent is nurtured, voices are heard, and careers thrive. Our Values Can-do attitude We take a resourceful, creative, bold approach to what we do. Every one of our team members is a big-thinker, who perpetually strives to do it all, is up for complex missions, and shares that “challenge accepted” energy. Data-driven everything Every step we make is based on meticulously collected data. Whether it’s business goals, creative aspects, media buying strategy, or task prioritization – we run countless tests to give us the smartest outputs. Trust Transparency is a big deal for us, and it’s been that way since the very beginning. Our mission is to establish relationships based on trust with publishers, clients, and users - we do so by complying with all privacy regulations, always. jobs.title: Content Quality Lead
jobs.description: Kueez For Publishers Performance Marketing About us Careers Apply p p p For Publishers Performance Marketing About us Careers Apply Content Quality Lead Employment Level: Location: Tel Aviv Date: August 17, 2026 Send application About the Role We are looking for a Content Quality Lead to oversee content quality, compliance, and editorial standards across our affiliate commerce activity. The role combines policy expertise with a strong editorial eye. It is responsible not only for identifying risks and approving content, but also for ensuring that all of our content materials align with each client’s brand voice, audience, and commercial objectives. The ideal candidate can balance client expectations, platform policies, user trust, operational needs, and business performance, while making practical decisions in complex or ambiguous situations. Key Responsibilities Review content, campaigns, landing pages, user flow, and messaging. Ensure compliance with client, merchant, and advertising platform requirements. Evaluate content for accuracy, editorial quality, credibility, and brand alignment. Identify content that may be technically compliant but off-brand, unclear, overly aggressive, or unsuitable for the target audience. Provide clear and practical guidance to content, creative, commercial, and operations teams. Lead policy and quality processes during major sales events and high-volume periods. Translate policy and client updates into actionable internal guidelines. Manage and train freelance QA reviewers. Implement and improve AI-assisted QA and content-review tools. Handle escalations and make balanced decisions when commercial, editorial, and compliance considerations conflict. Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements. Requirements Experience in affiliate marketing, e-commerce content, editorial operations, compliance, or quality assurance. Strong editorial judgment and understanding of brand voice, tone, and audience fit. Ability to interpret policies and apply them with flexibility and sound judgment. Strong cross-functional communication and decision-making skills. Experience managing freelancers or QA processes is an advantage. Experience with AI-based content-review tools is an advantage. Excellent English. Wanna work with us? Send application Think we can be a great match? We’d be happy to learn more about you. Just drop us your resume. jobs.description: Privacy Policy Kueez Monetization Suite End2End Marketing Platform About us Careers Contact us p p p Kueez Monetizations Suite End2End Marketing Platform About us Careers Contact us Privacy Policy Last update: May 2025 INTRODUCTION: This privacy policy (“ PrivacyPolicy ” or “ Policy ”) describes how Kueez Entertainment Ltd. (“ Kueez ”, “ we ”, “ us ”, or “ our ”) collects and uses, certain information, including your Personal Data and the choices you can make about your Personal Data we process. Kueez is a supply-side platform provider which enables digital assets owners (“ Publishers ”) and third-party advertisers and advertising networks (“ Advertisers ” and collectively with Publisher the “ Partners ”) to manage their advertising inventory (“ AdvertisingServices ”). This Privacy Policy governs the processing of data collected by Kueez in connection with: (i) visitors of our website, available at: https://weare.kueez.com/ or other official digital assets, such as our social media accounts (“ Visitors ” and " website " respectively); (ii) Publishers and Advertisers (and each of their authorized users) signing up (or log in) for and use of Kueez Services, including a designated account (“ Partner Account ”) dashboard environment, marketplace, execution of marketing campaigns, etc. (“ KueezPlatform ”); and (iii) Publisher's end users (“ End Users ”). Advertising Services, Kueez Platform and the Website shall be collectively referred to herein as the “ Services ”. Visitors, Publishers and End Users shall be further, separately and collectively, referred to herein as “ you ”. We strongly urge you to read this Policy and make sure that you fully understand and agree to it. If you do not agree to this Policy, please discontinue and avoid using our Services. You have the right to cease using our Services at any time. You are not legally required to provide us with any Personal Data, but without it we will not be able to provide you with the best experience of using our Services. DATA CONTROLLER: Kueez Entertainment Ltd., incorporated under the laws of the State of Israel, is the "data controller" (as such term is defined under the EU General Data Protection Regulation known as the “ GDPR ” or equivalent privacy legislation including the United Kingdom's General Data Protection Regulation and DataProtection Act; Collectively, the " UK GDPR ") of the Personal Data processed by it. This Privacy Policy also details the Personal Data we collect from End Users. However, you should review the Publisher’s policies as well, as they further and independently apply to its data collection practices, as well as provide contact information for requests to exercise your rights related to your Personal Data processed by such Publisher. TYPES OF DATA COLLECTED AND PURPOSES: Depending on your interaction with us, we may collect two types of Data from you: “Non-Personal Data” meaning aggregated, non-personal non-identifiable information, which may be made available or gathered via your access to and use of the Services. We are not aware of the identity of the user from which the Non-Personal Data is collected. Such Non-Personal Data may include aggregated usage information and technical information transmitted by your device, such as browser version, operating system type and version, mobile network information, device settings, and software data. “Personal Data” (as defined under the GDPR) or “Personal Information” (as defined under the US Privacy Laws) meaning individually identifiable information, namely information that identifies an individual or may, with reasonable effort, be used to identify an individual. For the avoidance of doubt, any Non-Personal Data connected or linked to any Personal Data shall be deemed as Personal Data as long as such connection or linkage exists. We do not knowingly collect or process any Personal Data constituting or revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, or trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data, data concerning a person's health, government identifiers, precise geolocation or data concerning a person’s sex life or sexual orientation (“ Special Categories of Personal Data ”). Such Online identifiers are usually kept for a few days. We may further collect Data related to your use and interaction with our website and Kueez Platform, such as directing campaign and URLs, pages viewed, access time and date, duration, clickstream, etc. (“ Usage Data ”).
